payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing the source and edited images, is the front overlap of the woman’s bright pink jacket reliably visible enough to determine whether it became more closed? Assess actual jacket-panel overlap or closure, not changes caused only by pose, motion, or viewpoint.
node.criteria: complete: the front is visibly fully closed in the edited image. partial: reliable comparison shows increased front-panel overlap or other visible closing progress, but the jacket is not fully closed. absent: reliable comparison shows no visible closing progress, or the front is visibly less closed; an open jacket alone is not sufficient if pose or viewpoint prevents comparison. unknown: the front overlap or change cannot be reliably judged because it is occluded, turned away, or obscured by pose, motion, or viewpoint.
node.binding: Visual target: the woman’s bright pink outer jacket. Compare the front panels and their overlap in source and edited images. Distinguish actual closure or increased overlap from the jacket swinging outward or apparent changes due to pose or viewpoint; use unknown if comparison is unreliable.

outcome.description: The woman’s jacket is closed fully.
outcome.reference: Make her close her jacket fully
